method_notes: RAW is the registered painting; CLIPPED uses a Euclidean 2-px guide dilation and fills missing guide pixels from decoded guide planes.
Guide ramp decoded by nearest kit palette RGB; alpha remains independent. One downscale and translation only.
Per-piece footprints use original T4e IDs, runtime inverse-affine bilinear sampling and actual erosion schedule; no resegmentation of paintings.
Positive per-layer alpha support is intersected with whole-guide alpha > 0.5, including translucent contributions; up to 1-px CPU/raster edge assignment is explicit.
Expanded guide has zero unexplained pixels; spent has one. This mapping limitation is reported and no failed state is bound.
Stroke instrument: mean band-0 medial-ridge diameter 2*EDT-1; 8-connected whole-image shard counts at alpha > 0.5.
VO8 exact indexed RGBA drawing changes use the stated shape band, not an invented temporal calibration.
Literal swap ages 15 and 36 are implemented. Existing fire v2 expansion end is 19, residue entry 40; the underlying clock remains unchanged.

Key-state distance fields are conditioned to retained coverage at entry, preventing double erosion; absolute root-layer erode and dissolve uniforms continue. Key materials use a whole-state field without piece noise.
